description.en: Applies a body/costume model ID to a "manip chara" slot — the manipulable character variant used to change a character's appearance (e.g. outfit) for a cutscene without touching the real playable model.
Manip character slot index (0 for the main manipulated character).
Body/costume model ID to apply to that slot.

example.code:
// Swap the manipulated character's body/outfit to model 902
CMND_CREATE_MANIP_CHARA(0, 902);
